ShortDescription.Value: Ban public street parking without tedious work. Pick per District, or use the single road button even for 1-way alleys.

Publish.LongDescription:
## 🅿️ Parking Control (PC)
Want clean curbs without changing your road design?
* 🚗 Easy to use; prevents cars and motorcycles from choosing public street parking. * No need to add grass or wide sidewalks as workarounds. * Ban parking on single roads, 1-way alleys, with the **No Parking** road button! 🚫
## Choose where
* ✅ **by District** - **Roadside Parking Ban** appears in district policies but nothing is disabled until you select a district and check the box. The manual no-parking button still also works in combination even if you have "by Districts". This is the most versatile and recommended choice.
* ✅ **Manual Only** - use the **No Parking** button wherever you want. This choice automatically turns off all district policies you may have enabled, and the district no-parking choice will not appear in the district panel. Note that you can still use the manual button even if you pick **by District**.
* ✅ **Whole City** - prevent street parking city-wide. Make sure the city has enough parking storage off street.
### Manual roads 🚫
Use the **No Parking** button next to the crosswalk tool.
* **Left-click** a road to add No Parking. * **Right-click** to remove it.
🚙 Parking lots and building parking stay working normally.
* Optional Status rows show parking usage; better details than the game's info view.
## Good to know
* Make sure your city has enough off-street parking. When parking is unavailable, the game may use outside-connection storage/staging as it does in vanilla. * Some vanilla roads already don't allow parking, e.g. 3-lane small roads, highways, 2-way alleys. * New or rebuilt roads may briefly accept a few cars while CS2 updates their parking lanes. * Safe to remove anytime and designed to not impact performance. * NEW 4-lane or 6-lane road ban toggles. These work in addition to the dropdown choices in the Options menu.
## Support and Feedback
* Support by clicking Like 👍 (top right); helps people know about the mod. * Feedback and PRs are welcome through the GitHub and Discord links on the right.
**Planned:** centralized parking-fee controls.
## Credits and Thanks
* River-mochi - mod author * yenyang - technical consultant * Dataknase, Maintyper, DragonFire - testing * StarQ - no parking icon

## How does it work
* The mod uses the game's own `ParkingDisabled` flag on eligible roads. * It does not narrow the road, widen the sidewalk, or add a driving lane; the road looks the same. * Existing parked cars gradually relocate after parking is banned. * New or rebuilt roads may briefly accept a few cars while CS2 updates their parking lanes. * Optional: works with [Mochi's Hover Colors](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/146044/Windows) - the manual road tool follows MHC's Bulldozer + Roads colors, just like normal road tools. * Manual No Parking is set per road segment. If you draw a road or train track perpendicular across a no-parking road, the game splits it into two new segments. Re-apply No Parking to the new halves. District and whole-city road-size bans are not affected by road splits.
